title: LearningAI practice notes (src/content/practice/<chapter>.json)
description: topicId -> projectId -> note, plus a _lab key for the chapter's lab scenarios.

_lab.description: projectId -> { scenario }: an HTML scenario for doing the chapter lab with that project.

additionalProperties.description: One topic: a note for each of the four projects.

practice.description: In practice: short HTML, about 25–45 words. Write the company and assistant as {company} and {assistant}.

failure.description: Failure to avoid: short HTML, about 12–25 words.

tryIt.description: Try it: what exactly to change in this topic's figure, or what to run on a laptop, with this project's dataset. About 25–45 words.

fit.description: How well the project suits the topic. A limited topic needs another project rated best or good.

fitNote.description: A short phrase on why the project suits the topic.
